item.title: BREAKING: 2028 Four-Star and No. 1 RB in the class of 2028 Micah Rhodes commits to OU
item.description: 2028 Klein Oak (TX) four-star and number one running back in the Class of 2028, Micah Rhodes, has announced his commitment to Oklahoma.Rhodes dropped a Top 3 consisting of Texas, Texas A&M and Oklahoma back on January 12th and now has decided that to call Norman his future home.
